scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Purchase Singel Net / Small Rampon Net & Its Accessories
other_conditions: Applicant must be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
Applicant must not possess any registered fishing canoes or fishing trawlers.
Only one member per household family can avail the benefit.
The fisherman’s grandparents must be residents of Goa.
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy up to ₹50,000 for the purchase of single net/small rampon net and its accessories, provided every five years.
documents_required: Self-attested copies of all mandatory documents (if required)
